# openwrt_firewall_include (Resource)

An include of a script or nftables snippet (`config include`).

Manages a `include` section in `/etc/config/firewall`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Path of the include on the router. (UCI option `path`.)
- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

- `chain` (String) Chain for chain-pre/chain-post. (UCI option `chain`.)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the include. (UCI option `enabled`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `fw4_compatible` (Boolean) Script is fw4 compatible. (UCI option `fw4_compatible`.)
- `position` (String) nftables include position. (UCI option `position`.) One of: `ruleset-pre`, `ruleset-post`, `table-pre`, `table-post`, `chain-pre`, `chain-post`.
- `reload` (Boolean) Re-run on firewall reload. (UCI option `reload`.)
- `type` (String) Include type. (UCI option `type`.) One of: `script`, `nftables`, `restore`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
